items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: Young man, nice young man. I got messed up.

ctx.x: Labor Day, the 4th of July, every band in the city. And made the 10th around there. Yeah.

In other words, the brass band from the E-Ricka to the Tuxedo band, I played with both of them. Brass bands. That's what I was in, you know what I mean? Young man, nice young man. I got messed up. Turned a corner fast.
When you, when you, you didn't get this stroke on a bandstand, did you?
